about: The plain-text part of E1 (ticked, unticked) and E-X, rendered by src/worker/messages.js from test/email-fixture.mjs's SAMPLE inputs at recorded_from, BEFORE the branding amendment (SPEC-rung5 § 9). M14 renders them again and compares byte for byte. The text part is the draft's wording: regenerate only when the WORDING is meant to change, and say so in the commit. Since SPEC-save-offer-production § 10 (2026-10-22: a WORDING change, E1's line for an offer without a code, "Your pricing is held until [date]") it also holds e1_held_ticked and e1_held_unticked, rendered from inputs.heldOffer at recorded_held_from; the three recorded from recorded_from are unchanged, byte for byte. Since SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass.md § 1 item 4 (2026-10-23, the Advisor: "Let's harmonize on 'held until'") a code's line reads "· held until" (it read "· good until"): e1_ticked's and e1_unticked's one line each, re-recorded from ede2e07's own tree; nothing else moved. Since SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass.md § 8 (2026-10-26, a WORDING change: E1 in the flyers' language, the band's words read from data/flyer-front.json, Claim my offer, the footer's new words, item 7's two lines removed) every E1 entry moved and two were added (e1_held_ended, e1_held_slideshow), and inputs gained noPhotos and photos (each sample names its own photo manifest): re-recorded from ac0ec8c's own tree (git archive), the recorder at 7961725 (the code before) first reproducing every committed entry byte for byte; ex unchanged, byte for byte. Since SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass.md § 8.2 item 1 (ruled ts=2026-10-27T15:04:57.804Z, a WORDING change: the consent line back in E1's footer, its words as before § 8) e1_ticked and e1_held_ticked moved, re-recorded from 78a677a's own tree, the recorder at a3dc524 (the code before) first reproducing every committed entry; every other entry byte-identical.
